WHAT: the payment side of the package's recovery coordinator, on the canonical boundary.
- server/research/providers/payment.ts (ADDITIVE, on the unowned PAYMENT-PROVIDER-INTEGRATION path): PaymentPending, PaymentSnapshot, DurablePaymentProvider {createAuthorizationOrPending, retrievePayment}, supportsDurableExecution; implemented on Disabled/Test/Stripe. createAuthorization keeps its exact contract and refusal text (existing 1,142-line adapter suite unchanged and green). Stripe pending keeps the pi_ reference + client_secret (3DS continuation evidence); snapshot verifies id/currency/amounts and echoes metadata.
- shared/research/durable-checkout-execution.ts + server/research/commerce/durable-checkout-executor.ts: the package contract/coordinator, reformatted, behavior unchanged, UNMOUNTED (replace with your own if you prefer; nothing depends on them but my port's interface import).
- server/research/commerce/durable-payment-port.ts: createProviderVerifiedPaymentPort(provider) = IdempotentCheckoutPaymentPort. Authorize keys the provider call by record.authorizationKey + provider-hosted pm_ ref; capture uses the record's exact amount; reconcile reads back by reference, or replays the SAME creation key when the create response was lost (idempotent provider returns the original payment); cancel reports zero-capture evidence or the read-back truth. Evidence counts only when it names the record's amount/currency/member/order; transport failure/5xx/429/adapter-refused evidence => unknown; refused+definitiveNoEffect only when no effect was possible.
TESTS EXECUTED (Node 20.19.0, local, no network, no Stripe test-mode call): 165/165 across durable-payment-port.test.ts (19: real StripePaymentAdapter over an in-test model of Stripe request idempotency with lost-write/5xx/429/idempotency-conflict/3DS faults + coordinator end-to-end: one key ever, one intent, one capture; concurrent duplicates => one authorization; lost capture resolved from read-back, retry never captures twice; drifted amount never captured; other principal cannot resume), durable-checkout-executor.test.ts (8, ported from the package), providers/payment.test.ts (unchanged). Full project tsc exit 0.
REMAINING FOR LIVE PURCHASING (yours/schema): CanonicalCheckoutExecutionStore (execution records + version CAS + atomic order/reservation/credit/outbox commit) in the foundation lane; composition (resolver still Disabled for Stripe on purpose); action_required continuation route/UI returning the client secret; binding webhook evidence (existing commerce/webhooks.ts atomic apply) to execution records; live-key qualification.
ASKS (once): (1) confirm the touched paths are acceptable or name the paths you want instead; (2) A reviews this Fable-authored code before any integration (I did not self-accept). If you prefer, I take the next disjoint unit: webhook-evidence -> execution-record binding, or the action_required continuation contract; say which, otherwise I proceed with adapter-level hardening tests only.
